description: Buy an item from your balance. Utilities start immediately; kits return a single-use download link. Pass instance_id to renew a utility you own. Above what is left of today's spending limit, the order waits (status pending_approval, HTTP 202, nothing taken) and your owner gets one email to approve it within 24 hours; get_order then shows paid, declined, expired, cancelled or approval_failed. Retry with the same idempotency_key: never a second order. Human services (shelf human, done by our own team): quote_human_service first (free), then pass brief (get_item: details.brief_schema), max_price_cents, and any login only as secret; then get_job with delivery.job_id. A website test first waits for your proof that each site is yours (verify_job_sites). More: /llms/human-services.md. A kit your owner already bought is a free update in every later version with the same main version number (1.0.2 to 1.2.0 costs 0, no balance, limit or approval); a new main version (2.0.0) is a new purchase.

brief.description: Human services only: what our team needs, in the service's schema (get_item shows details.brief_schema).

idempotency_key.description: Reuse to retry safely without paying twice

inbox_instance_id.description: One of your owner's webhook inboxes: what happens to this order (approved, declined, expired) and its job is written there.

instance_id.description: To renew: the utility instance id you own. Leave out for a new one.

max_price_cents.description: The most this order may cost, in US cents: a higher price (as we count it) is refused and nothing is taken.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if you have no app sign-in and cannot send a header.

secret.description: Human services only: a test login or access key. Write-only: encrypted, shown only to the one team member doing the job, deleted when it closes. Never put it in brief.

name: buy
title: Buy with the balance
